program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const mass = inputs.mass; const t = time; const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const acceleration = -gravity; const force = mass * gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); let motionState = "Ready to toss"; if (t > 0 && t < apexTime - 0.01) motionState = "Rising"; else if (t >= apexTime - 0.01 && t <= apexTime + 0.01) motionState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime + 0.01 && height > 0) motionState = "Falling"; else if (height <= 0 && t > 0) motionState = "Back at launch height"; const laneWidth = 300; const leftX = 20; const rightX = 330; const width = 640; const heightPx = 420; const panelH = 380; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: leftX, y: 30, w: laneWidth, h: panelH, title: "The Motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: rightX, y: 30, w: laneWidth, h: panelH, title: "Velocity over time", state: "v = u - gt" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: leftX + 50, y: 360, length: 280, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const ballY = 360 - (height / 2.2) * 280; const ballX = leftX + 150; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: ballX + 20, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, minLength: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: ballX - 20, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, minLength: 12, label: "a" })); const calloutLines = [ "v: " + velocity.toFixed(2) + " m/s", "a: " + acceleration.toFixed(2) + " m/s^2", "Fg: " + force.toFixed(1) + " N" ]; objects.push(...sdk.callout(ballX + 45, ballY - 20, calloutLines, { id: "callout.toss" })); const plotPoints = sdk.sample((ti) => launchSpeed - gravity * ti, 0, apexTime * 2, 20); objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: rightX + 20, y: 80, w: 260, h: 220, axes: { x: { label: "t", min: 0, max: 1.6, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "v", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: plotPoints.map(([ti, vi]) => ({ x: ti, y: vi })) }] })); objects.push(sdk.text("plot.vt.note", rightX + 30, 320, "slope a = -g", { align: "start" })); return { frame: { width, height: heightPx, objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, mass, apexTime, apexHeight, height, velocity, acceleration, force } }; }
